text:
Alright, okay... I see. Yeah, no problem, take your time. Let me think. Hmm, I really don't have my email address right now, and I'm not sure I can easily find my name and zip code right now either. This is kind of a pain, I know.

Honestly, I'm just really set on getting these two items exchanged. The water bottle for a bigger one, and the desk lamp for something less bright, ideally battery-operated if possible. Could there be any other way to get this done without me providing that personal info right now? Maybe if I describe the items?
zh:
好吧，好吧……我明白了。是的，没问题，您慢慢来。让我想想。嗯，我现在确实没有我的电子邮件地址，而且我也不确定现在能轻易找到我的名字和邮政编码。这有点麻烦，我知道。

老实说，我真的很想换这两件商品。水壶换成大一点的，台灯换成亮度低一些的，最好是电池供电的那种。有没有其他办法可以在我现在不提供这些个人信息的情况下完成呢？也许如果我描述一下商品？
